mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months lowers discount rates, increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% in a single month reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which reduces the real interest rate and increases S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs for 2 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which raises the real interest rate and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,000 units for 3 consecutive months indicates robust consumer demand, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 for 2 consecutive months suggests expanding supply capacity, which lowers the real interest rate and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns within 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for 3 consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which raises the real interest rate and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tight labor periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months indicates a weakening labor market, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
